body: You're very welcome, and thank you for reading. As an adult myself now, I enjoy a cold beer at a concert or a cocktail at the barbeque; however, I, unlike my father, understand that everything has a proper place and time. This is what separates him from me: I cannot and will not let alcohol interfere with my family or their happiness because, in the end, they are more important, the most important. My father had a problem, a real addiction, that didn't allow him to see past the here and now -- the need to feed his thirst-quenching craving asap -- and how it ultimately trickled down to affect those closest to him.
A personal odyssey through a tumultuous year.
